items.name: 5.12 kWh Wall-Mounted LFP Battery
items.summary: A compact low-voltage battery format for residential solar storage and selected backup loads. Wall mounting saves floor space, while parallel connection allows a compatible system to expand around changing energy needs.
features: Up to eight batteries in parallel

image.alt: Supplier wall-mounted LFP battery units with orange status displays; branding removed

items.notes: Supplier-reference configuration; confirm inverter compatibility before ordering. The listing gives conflicting enclosure IP ratings and dimension ordering, so those fields are not reproduced. Photo is a supplier family image edited only to remove branding and overlays; enclosure appearance must be confirmed for the ordered variant. No warranty or certification claim is made.

items.name: 5.12 kWh Rack-Mounted LFP Battery

specs.label: Cycle-life test condition
specs.value: >6,000 cycles at 80% DOD, as stated in the supplier datasheet

items.summary: A standard rack-format module for organized indoor battery installations. The 4U enclosure brings together a local display, battery management and communication interfaces for compatible residential and off-grid solar storage systems.

image.alt: 4U rack-mounted 51.2 V 100 Ah battery with terminal connectors, handles and status display; branding removed

items.notes: This entry uses the 4U variant only; a separate 3U product has different dimensions. Parallel quantity follows the February 2026 datasheet rather than older 40-unit literature. Supplier photo obtained from https://www.leoch.com/products/lithium/residential-rack-mounted-battery and edited only to remove the brand mark. Cycle life is a stated test condition, not a site-life guarantee.

items.name: 5 kW / 10.24 kWh All-in-One Solar Storage
items.summary: A combined battery and solar inverter format for smaller energy projects. The integrated enclosure reduces separate equipment requirements, with a 10.24 kWh battery and MPPT input for a compatible PV array.
features: Battery and inverter integrated in one enclosure

image.alt: White all-in-one solar battery and inverter enclosure with central display and black horizontal band; branding removed

source.title: Enjoy Solar ES-ESS-BP51200 supplier specification — Made-in-China

items.notes: Specifications follow the BP51200 column, not the smaller BP51100. The listing disagrees on output voltage, enclosure thickness and cooling wording; those values are omitted pending the selected variant's final datasheet. Photo is the supplier product-family image with branding removed. No transfer-time, grid-compliance or warranty guarantee is inferred.

items.name: 100 kW / 215 kWh Air-Cooled Storage Cabinet
items.summary: An air-cooled cabinet format for commercial and industrial energy storage. Its integrated battery enclosure supports larger energy requirements, with cloud monitoring described by the supplier for operational visibility and remote parameter management.

image.alt: Air-cooled storage cabinet with external cooling unit, front indicator lights and emergency stop button

source.title: Run Strategy 100 kW × 215 kWh air-cooled cabinet specification
source.model: 100 KW × 215 KWh Air-cooled Energy Storage Cabinet (supplier product family; no SKU published)

items.notes: No separate manufacturer SKU is published on the source page. Photo is the actual unbranded image from that product page, without generative changes. Backup operation requires confirmation of the PCS, transfer equipment and supported loads; this catalog does not claim seamless backup or a guaranteed runtime.

items.name: 100 kW / 215 kWh Liquid-Cooled Storage Cabinet
items.summary: An integrated commercial cabinet with liquid thermal management. The supplier configuration combines battery, power conversion and energy controls for site-level storage, with optional architecture changes required for islanded operation or multi-cabinet installations.
features: Battery, BMS, PCS and EMS integration

image.alt: Liquid-cooled commercial battery cabinet with doors, indicator lights, emergency stop and lower vents; branding removed

items.notes: Supplier-reference model, not a claim of Lantian manufacture. The source states grid-connected operation as basic; off-grid and parallel operation require extra accessories and software. Photo is the original supplier cabinet image edited to remove branding, watermark lettering and certification overlays. Market-specific compliance, delivery scope and the ordered enclosure must be confirmed.

items.name: 3.73 MWh Liquid-Cooled Battery Container
items.summary: A high-voltage battery container for larger energy infrastructure. Liquid cooling and containerized packaging provide a scalable battery block, with the external PCS, transformer and project protection design determined by the selected system architecture.

image.alt: 20-foot liquid-cooled battery container with side service doors and front cooling assembly; branding removed

items.notes: This is a DC battery-container reference, not a guaranteed complete AC system. The marketplace title incorrectly uses MW and a table labels a kWh value as power; only the separately stated nominal energy is reproduced, and no AC output power is inferred. The listing disagrees on fire-suppression detail, so that field is omitted. Exact supplier photo edited only to remove brand logos; final configuration and enclosure details require confirmation.
